messages:
nora_support: Escalating StreamlineX onboarding - large dataset ingest failing with intermittent 429s, many records DROPPED. Ticket #112233, trial ends in 6 days. :frowning:

diego_cs: This impacts renewal signal. Need a comms plan + priority fix.

ryan_ingest: Logs show batch_queue_full and rate-limiter spikes. Likely caused by default SDK parallelism and large file sizes.

megan_se: They uploaded ~1.2M rows across multiple files. We should offer assisted ingest and temporary tenant burst.

tara_ops: Approve temporary burst for tenant=streamlinex for 2h. Will create ops ticket and rollback conditions.

support_bot: OPS ticket OPS-770 created.

nora_support: Scheduling assisted ingest in 45m and sending temporary token. Attaching error sample: `ERROR ingest: record_id=abc123 dropped reason=batch_queue_full attempts=3`.

ryan_ingest: Applied concurrency bump and burst; backlog draining, drop rate falling from ~28% to ~2% within 10m.

diego_cs: I'll offer +7 day trial extension and send a summary of immediate actions and permanent roadmap.

megan_se: Permanent fixes: SDK auto-chunking + client backoff + server queuing improvements. Docs update and sample script prioritized for 2 weeks; full server work ~6 weeks.

tara_ops: Added monitoring task for per-tenant ingest alerts. Runbook link: https://runbook.redwood.ai/ingest/tenant-burst.

nora_support: Customer completed assisted ingest, confirms all records present and accepted +7 day extension. Marking account Warm.

diego_cs: Action owners recap: nora_support - comms & follow-up; ryan_ingest - RCA & monitor; megan_se - SDK + docs; tara_ops - ops ticket & monitoring. Keeping thread open until ENG-INGEST-991 RCA and SDK PR scheduled. :white_check_mark:
